name: @turboslide/materials
description: The material catalog (SPEC 5.4): Paper Shaders paper:* entries with uniform schemas and GT palette presets, the proto:* engines as unavailable entries (open question 9), recipe resolution and the recipe key, the main-thread mount for the editor's live preview, the headless capture of frozen frames at anchors (plain and two-tone) and the asset action handlers (asset.add, asset.dither, asset.capture, material.capture, material.list) every transport registers. The features round adds the eleven common controls (controls.ts), the kit palette (presets.ts), the frame key (recipe-key.ts), the gallery stills (previews.ts, previews/) and the shader.* actions.
